description: Defines the VideoDecoder class for Raspberry Pi 4, implementing video decoding functionalities using OpenMax components, including thread management, buffer handling, and decoder interface methods.

classes.name: VideoDecoder
classes.description: A class implementing a video decoder for Raspberry Pi using OpenMax, managing buffers, threading, and decoder state.

methods.name: VideoDecoder
methods.description: Constructor initializing the VideoDecoder with a specific video codec.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the decoder with callback functions for status and error reporting.

methods.name: GetPrerollFrameCount
methods.description: Returns the number of preroll frames, fixed at 1.

methods.name: GetPrerollTimeout
methods.description: Returns the maximum timeout for preroll, set to maximum 64-bit integer.

methods.name: GetMaxNumberOfCachedFrames
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of cached frames, set to 12.

methods.name: WriteInputBuffers
methods.description: Feeds input buffers into the decoder.

methods.name: WriteEndOfStream
methods.description: Signals end of stream to the decoder.

methods.name: GetCurrentDecodeTarget
methods.description: Returns the current decode target, always invalid in this implementation.
